items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Now would he be related to the organ player that come from out there, Charles Kinard?

ctx.x: Now would he be related to the organ player that come from out there, Charles Kinard?

I don't know. I don't think so. I don't think so. But anyway, we used to spend all afternoon putting the record back and forth until we got the solo that we wanted. And his ideal was Prince Robinson for one, and he had others. But mine was mostly Cootie and Louis.
